name: Microgrid restoration return-to-normal handover
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Transfers control from the restoration coordinator to the assigned stable operating mode.
description: Transfers control from the restoration coordinator to the assigned stable operating mode. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Restoration complete and mode readiness” at the input and “Normal-mode control ownership” at the output. The handover must preserve resource limits and authority.
